items.title: Southeast Natural Gas Cash Price Plunge Checks National Average
items.summary: Spot natural gas prices slumped in the Southeast on Monday as robust supply matched impressive near-term demand and presented the possibility for imbalance as weather demand tapers into the fall season.

items.title: Hormuz Closure, Storage Gap Keep Europe Bidding for US LNG
items.summary: Cooling demand is retreating from northwest Europe and the Iberian Peninsula, but a still-shuttered Strait of Hormuz and the thinnest August storage in years are driving European buyers ahead of Asia in the hunt for US cargoes.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Falter as Supply Swells, Weather Demand Signals Fade
items.summary: Natural gas futures drifted lower on Monday as traders weighed strong near-term cooling demand against looming fall weather and plump supply readings.

items.title: Global Natural Gas Prices Continue Climbing as Hopes of US-Iran Peace Deal Fade
items.summary: Global energy prices climbed on Monday as tensions in the Middle East showed no signs of easing.

items.title: Power Burn Rebound Helps Natural Gas Futures Off Intraday Lows
items.summary: Natural gas futures bounced off a key technical floor Monday, trimming steep early losses by midday as slipping production and firming power burn offset weekend forecasts that shed some heat.

items.title: Permian Natural Gas Egress Expands as 4.5 Bcf/d Solitude System Advances
items.summary: WhiteWater and partners have made a final investment decision (FID) on the Solitude Pipeline System, which would add additional natural gas egress out of the booming Permian Basin.

items.title: August Turns Up the Heat as Natural Gas Storage Build Shrinks
items.summary: So much for July typically being the hottest month in the contiguous United States.

items.title: US Natural Gas Storage Cushion Has a South Central Catch
items.summary: The Midwest may be building a hefty natural gas storage cushion ahead of winter, but that does not mean the region will stop competing for South Central supplies when heating demand peaks.

items.title: Waha Prices Rise With Pipeline Expansion, but Is Natural Gas Quality the Next Issue?
items.summary: Thanks to the first of many planned pipeline projects entering service this summer, Permian Basin natural gas prices have moved firmly back in positive territory. NGI’s Waha averaged around $1.64/MMBtu in July and is averaging just over $2.00 so far

items.title: Ksi Lisims Feedgas Link Advances With Prince Rupert Pipeline Award
items.summary: The Prince Rupert Gas Transmission (PRGT) project has awarded its first onshore construction contract, advancing the planned feedgas link for the proposed Ksi Lisims LNG export terminal in British Columbia (BC).

items.title: U.S. Shale Majors Cut Spending Despite Higher Oil Prices
items.summary: U.S. oil companies dominating the shale patch are planning to trim their spending plans and instead take advantage of higher international oil prices to reduce debt and boost shareholder returns. This is bad news for production growth. Bloomberg repo

items.title: Russia Receives First Gasoline Cargo From India as Fuel Shortages Spread

items.title: Chevron Strikes Oil and Gas Offshore Angola in Major Discovery
items.summary: Chevron has announced a new oil and gas condensate discovery offshore Angola, hitting more than 2,000 feet of hydrocarbons in a Block 0 exploration well that could be tied directly into the company’s existing production infrastructure in the country.

items.title: Libya Power Crisis Explodes as Grid Fails Again
